北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗但体感较冷，风大干燥，注意保暖和补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels chilly. Mind the wind and dryness, stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴好有风，体感稍凉，记得添衣别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny with wind, feels a bit cool. Remember to add clothes to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有霾，体感微凉。外出请戴口罩，注意防护哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has haze, feels cool. Please wear a mask when going out and stay protected.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云舒适，体感宜人。早晚温差注意穿搭哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and pleasant. Mind the temperature difference between morning and evening!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光明媚，温暖如春。出门记得防晒哟！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and warm like spring. Remember your sun protection when heading out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感微凉。早晚温差大，别忘了添衣。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny but feels a bit cool. Mind the large temperature difference, remember to add clothes.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，体感稍凉。外出戴好口罩，注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has haze, feels a bit cool. Wear a mask when out, and stay warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阳光正好，体感舒适。享受这惬意天气吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and feels comfortable. Enjoy this pleasant weather!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，体感微凉。记得戴口罩，注意健康哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, feels cool. Remember to wear a mask and mind your health!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗但体感冷，风干。记得多穿衣多喝水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but feels cold and dry. Remember to layer up and drink more water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感舒适。外出散步，心情一定很棒！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and comfortable. A walk outside will surely brighten your mood!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗但严寒，体感 -9℃。务必裹严实，别冻着！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but severely cold, feels like -9℃. Please bundle up to avoid freezing!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -4℃。天气较冷，注意防寒保暖哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like -4℃. It's quite cold, so stay warm and protect against the chill!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗有风，体感微凉干燥。注意补水和添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and windy, feels cool and dry. Remember to hydrate and add clothes.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天有风，体感略凉。注意防风保暖哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and windy, feels a bit cool. Mind the wind and stay warm!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感仅 2℃。记得多穿些，小心着凉！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, but feels only 2℃. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 1℃ 左右。出门记得防寒保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels around 1℃. Remember to protect against the cold when you go out!
